name: Star Atlas library and connected port commons
source: Current directory_allocations.json; master v0.3 chapters4,5,6,21,32 and the four supplied library references. Programme labels remain unchanged.

lift.implementation: Extend the existing reusable lift with a three-stop authored control-panel variant. Preserve current two-stop defaults and identities; no second controller.

level_roles.D12: Public Star Atlas library: arrival desk, reachable collections, shared study and sheltered reading bays. Tall court relates these activities to the commons above.
level_roles.D13: Port residential commons: legible local arrival, shared tables and a quiet library overlook; preserve access toward existing guest allocations.
level_roles.D14: Quieter port commons and reading retreats: an offset overlook and different stair arrival, rather than a copy of the lower balcony.

view_policy: Real inward glazing faces the botanical atrium through verified open volume. West-side exterior glass is not assumed: the hull and intervening space require separate verification. Celestial diagrams are clearly intentional library displays, not fake exterior windows.
privacy_policy: Guest-room and environmental boundaries remain separate. Existing sleeping, changing and bathing privacy requirements are not removed to gain a view.
capacity_policy: No new accommodation, berth, business or passenger admission is created. Seating capacity follows actual supported furniture and later operational review, not floor area alone.

stair_cut_policy: Union court, stair and lift cuts before triangulation and author one coordinated floor-edge guard. Never construct overlapping polygon holes or independently guard through a stair.
